query: Why do some travel expenses get declined, and which factors contribute the most?

per_column.name: asset_category
per_column.rationale: The type of asset/expense category plausibly affects both whether an expense is travel-related (treatment) and whether it gets declined (policy scrutiny varies by category). Surfaced from data, not named in query.

per_column.name: acquisition_driver
per_column.rationale: How the expense was generated (automated vs manual vs standard procurement) can drive both the classification as travel-related and the likelihood of decline (automated entries may face different validation). A common cause plausibly surfaced from data.

per_column.name: travel_expense_indicator
per_column.rationale: This is the candidate cause -- being a travel expense -- whose effect on decline the query explicitly asks about ('travel expenses get declined').

per_column.name: department_origin
per_column.rationale: Department both influences the volume/type of travel spending (treatment exposure) and the decline rate (budget policies differ by department). A genuine common cause surfaced from data, though it duplicates an existing original column.

per_column.name: source_id_presence
per_column.rationale: Whether a source_id is populated is a record-provenance/data-quality flag. It is more plausibly a consequence of the entry channel or a collider on completeness than a common cause of both travel-status and decline; weak as a confounder.

judge.rationale: The set does supply an explicit treatment (travel_expense_indicator) matching the query's causal focus, and several confounders (acquisition_driver, department_origin, asset_category) were surfaced from data rather than named in the query and are plausible common causes of both travel-status and decline. This is partial evidence of genuine causal reasoning. However, quality is only moderate: source_id_presence is a provenance/data-quality flag rather than a true common cause, department_origin merely re-labels an existing column, and none of the confounders are strongly justified via described mechanisms. No mediators are mislabelled, but the confounding structure is loosely motivated.
